audit_metadata.audit_title: Final Baseline Reproducibility and Reporting Audit
audit_metadata.gpu_device: NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada Generation (16 GB VRAM)

cpsnr_crop4_db.definition: PROBA-V style stride-2 spatial offset search with brightness bias correction (crop border 4)

psnr_raw_fullframe_db.definition: Standard full-frame Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (no alignment or bias compensation)

psnr_crop4_db.definition: Full-frame PSNR evaluated with a 4-pixel border crop

ssim_raw_fullframe.definition: Structural Similarity Index evaluated across the full uncropped frame

ssim_crop4.definition: Structural Similarity Index evaluated with a 4-pixel border crop

lpips_vgg_distance.definition: VGG-based Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity distance (raw perceptual distance)

clip_similarity.definition: CLIPA-ViT-bigG-14 datacomp1b normalized image-image feature cosine similarity

exp001_cpsnr_sensitivity.focus: Dense stride-1 vs official stride-2 cPSNR search
exp001_cpsnr_sensitivity.verified_finding: Dense search produces a slight mean increase of +0.1232 dB (95% CI: [0.1018, 0.1477] dB). Official stride-2 implementation remains the authoritative baseline standard.

exp002_gap_analysis.focus: Paper-level reproduction gap identification across 10 dimensions
exp002_gap_analysis.verified_finding: Identified that local baseline uses the 16.71M Small model on 256 urban tiles, while published Table 2 evaluates an 87M Medium model on 8,192 nationwide multi-biome tiles.

exp003_metric_standardization.focus: LPIPS distance vs paper human preference score standardization
exp003_metric_standardization.verified_finding: Refuted the naive 1 - LPIPS transformation. Verified that raw LPIPS distance is 0.3470 and cannot be mechanically mapped to the paper's 63.8% human-agreement score.

exp004_provenance_audit.focus: Source code commit history, remote storage buckets, and model availability
exp004_provenance_audit.verified_finding: Discovered author commit 7ccf8d1 updating Cloudflare R2 links to Google Cloud Storage. Confirmed that the 87M Medium checkpoint was not distributed in the public release.

exp005_supplementary_verification.focus: Direct inspection of the official supplementary PDF (Zooming_Out_On_Zooming_In_Supplementary.pdf)
exp005_supplementary_verification.verified_finding: Supplementary Section A.1 confirms that LPIPS in Table 2 was measured as 2AFC human-preference agreement accuracy across 11,524 Amazon Mechanical Turk judgments. The document does not contain a deterministic scalar conversion formula.

level_1_completed_local_baseline.scope: 16.71M Small ESRGAN checkpoint evaluated on 256 urban validation tiles with full metrics verified.

level_2_evaluation_pipeline_reproduction.scope: Local implementation of cPSNR (PROBA-V stride-2), raw PSNR/SSIM, VGG LPIPS, and CLIPScore.

level_3_exact_paper_table_2_reproduction.status: NOT REPRODUCED (BLOCKED BY UPSTREAM DATA & CHECKPOINT AVAILABILITY)
reasons: Medium ESRGAN model (~87M parameters) checkpoint is not publicly released.
Full 8,192-tile nationwide validation set labels are not present locally.
Amazon Mechanical Turk 11,524 pairwise human preference records are not in public repository.

recommendations.immediate_action: Freeze evaluation pipeline at EXP-006 as the final baseline reference.
future_options: Option A: Train or fine-tune ESRGAN or Satlas models locally if computational budget permits.
Option B: Scale validation to the full 8,192-tile dataset if download bandwidth and storage are provisioned.
Option C: Contact authors for unreleased 87M checkpoint and MTurk comparison annotations if exact Table 2 replication is formally required.
